dataset_role: primary kinematic reference for hip/knee angles and waveform corridors
source: DR-NTU Dataverse / Roberts et al. Scientific Data 2026

angle_convention.knee: clinical flexion in degrees, calculated as 180 - hip-knee-ankle internal angle
angle_convention.hip: sagittal thigh angle relative to vertical; flexion positive, extension negative

spatiotemporal_note: NTU spatiotemporal output is exploratory only; use Yishun Study as the main clinical reference for speed, cadence, stride length, stance percent, and step width.
